display_name: Zuora: Get SQL Data Query Job
description: Read one SQL Data Query job (GET /query/jobs/{job_id}): queryStatus, outputRows, processingTime and, when completed, the dataFile location. Returns job_id/status queued at once; dispatch is not completion.
embedding_description: Read one Zuora SQL Data Query job by id: query status, the statement, output row count, processing time, remaining retries and, once completed, the result file location. Poll it after submit_data_query until the status is completed, failed or cancelled.

result_processor_customizations.action_label: Zuora SQL data query job read
result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued job envelope. Completion carries the job record in data; dataFile is a time-limited vendor URL, so prefer download_data_query_result to fetch it.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Queued is not completion. On completion relay HTTP status, ids and states exactly as Zuora returned them; a write or delete may have changed vendor state, so do not replay it automatically. Credential values never appear; [REDACTED] marks where Zuora echoed one.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Read one SQL Data Query job (GET /query/jobs/{job_id}): queryStatus, outputRows, processingTime and, when completed, the dataFile location.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: zuora.invalid_params is input that does not match Zuora's documented shape or an output/input path outside export_allowed_roots (zuora.export_path_refused). zuora.permission_denied is the vendor's 403 for the registered OAuth client's role, with Zuora's reason. zuora.object_not_found, zuora.validation_failed (vendor 4xx), zuora.query_failed (Data Query 4xx), zuora.rate_limited and zuora.api_error map Zuora's answer; zuora.auth_failed is a 401 credential failure.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Correct the parameters, or ask the Zuora administrator to grant the OAuth client's role the needed Workflow, Data Query or Files permission. Read current vendor state with the matching get or list verb before retrying a write. Back off on rate limits.
